additional_info.subject: ID0420729-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117152] PT1000 Error CRM:00798002113
additional_info.body:
Hi Yigit,
We have investigated the logs and Our observations are as following:
We could see the BT4 is reporting temperatures >70 degrees, and overheating.
Here
"OHW:" → sensor reading is above the overheat warning
"OHS:" → sensor reading is above the overheat shutdown limit
"OHSe:" → sensor reading was above the defined level, service is necessary
We need to check for the following connections and resistance across the BT4.
Resistance should read as per the PT1000 Table in accordance with Ambient temperature.
Pls disconnect wire from XD41 and check resistance across XD41, pin B and Pin D.
We recommend having Spare BT4 sensor while site intervention.
Also, Pls check if temperature is actually raising that much inside the chimney.
Do let us know if you need assistance in site intervention for troubleshooting.
